issues.quote: net income reached $72.4 billion in fiscal 2024, up from $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: FY2024 net income was $88.1 billion, not $72.4 billion. As written, the sentence shows no growth, which contradicts the claim that profit expanded faster than revenue. Growth was about 21.8% on unrounded figures ($88,136M / $72,361M), so the fact sheet is correct.

data.summary: The fiscal 2024 net income figure is wrong: it should be $88.1B, not $72.4B. All other figures are accurate. The +21.8% growth rate is correct on unrounded figures; 21.7% only comes from using rounded numbers.
